description: Compress a GIF by the only three things a GIF has — frames, colours and size. Nothing uploaded. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

colours.description: Colours in each frame's palette, one of 256, 128, 64, 32, 16. Fewer colours make a smaller file at the cost of banding in gradients.

gif.description: The animated or still GIF file as base64. The result is also a GIF.

keepEvery.description: Drop frames to shrink the file: 1 keeps every frame, 2 keeps every second one, 3 every third. Each kept frame takes on the delay of the frames dropped after it, so the animation runs for the same time.

name.description: The input filename. The result is named after it with '-small.gif' appended to the stem.

scale.description: A size factor per edge, 1 being the original size. Over the API only 1 is accepted; any other value is refused, because scaling happens in the browser tool alone.

name: gif_compressor
title: GIF Compressor
